title: Funnel
description: Shows an ordered set of stages as bars: either drop-off from stage to stage, or how many items sit at each step right now.
x-use-when: A process with ordered stages: a fulfillment pipeline (ordered, awaiting receipt, received, shipped, invoiced), a sales pipeline, or any flow where stage-to-stage drop-off or the count waiting at each step matters.
x-dont-use-when: The categories have no natural order (use bar_chart), they are parts of one whole with no flow (use donut), or the user needs the individual orders (use table).
x-checks: Error when two stages share a label.
Warns when a stage in a conversion funnel is larger than the stage before it (the data is probably a snapshot: use mode "snapshot").
Warns when every stage is null.

stages.description: Stages in process order, first step first.

value.description: Raw count or amount for the stage. Use null when it is unknown, never 0.

detail.description: Optional short context for the stage, e.g. "Avg 4.2 days in stage".

mode.description: conversion: each stage counts everything that reached it, so it shows % of the previous stage and % of the first. snapshot: each stage counts what is sitting there right now, so it shows each stage's share of the total.

format.description: How stage values are displayed. Use integer for counts of orders or lines, currency for dollar amounts.
